purpose: Machine-readable ownership coverage for profile-specific DGAF artifacts without flattening profile specialization into the core kernel.

profiles.name: AOSS v0.6 Stage-A assurance/validation profile

sections.description: Measurement manifest, observer boundary, comparator, failure ground truth, endpoint/multiplicity and effect rules.
Runtime, dependency, source-driver, executable/destination and installed-environment binding.
Collection authorization, policy-input mapping and fail-closed Stage-A decision policy.
Precollection/replay receipts, attempt integrity, freshness and artifact identity.
Predata readiness, preflight and execution-identity readiness without outcome promotion.
External admission/trust intake, reverification, local adjudication and retained review packets.

profiles.authority_boundary: AOSS may observe, normalize, validate, recommend, or produce profile-scoped decisions; it does not inherit DGAF-wide governance authority or establish scientific efficacy/independence by itself.

profiles.name: DGAF self-application / cold-start validation profile

sections.description: Manifest, scaffold and exact mutation declarations.
Same-system evidence adjudication and execution records.
Detector ablation and controlled mutation experiments.

profiles.authority_boundary: Self-application evidence remains same-system/nonindependent unless a separately evidenced independent process establishes otherwise.

profiles.name: Track / Epoch experimental lifecycle profile

sections.description: Custody keys, drills, admission and precollection preflight.
Collection admission, evidence admission, pre-lock ledger and dataset-lock evidence/receipts.
Locked primary-analysis execution/result records and synthetic oracle support.
Interpretation records, final closure and post-interpretation disposition.

profiles.authority_boundary: Track/Epoch records are exact-scope experimental lifecycle controls; they do not create a second general DGAF state/authorization engine.
